limitations: All 24 nontrivial handlers are tested only on the stated common prefix state (runtime bit 0, indices 0/1/1/0, service flag 0, inactive op4). Execution intentionally stops before each first publish literal; handler completion/frame behavior is not asserted.

Ready/timeout is modeled; only the two selected readiness states and fixed delays are covered. Flag2/7, active op4, other input paths, dynamic hardware behavior, caller ownership and physical effects remain unresolved.
No whole-handler completeness or canonical admission.
